title: pick up the black bowl on the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate
instruction: pick up the black bowl on the wooden cabinet and place it on the plate
note: An honest failure: the arm reaches, grasps and lifts, then runs out of the 44-decision horizon still carrying the bowl towards the plate. It is also the one episode here where the model's own grounding pick disagrees with the text rule the arm actually follows.
